subject.title: feat(openclaw): support pinning release version via openclaw_version

question: Should this installer officially support an opt-in `openclaw_version` release pin, with operators responsible for deliberate upgrades while the default remains `latest`?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and preserves the existing default, but accepting a persistent version-pinning setting defines the repository’s supported production update policy.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in pin
options.body: Accept exact release pinning as a supported installer contract while retaining `latest` for existing users.

options.title: Keep latest-only policy
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and keep release-mode updates exclusively on the existing moving-tag workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in pin
recommendation.body: Accept exact release pinning as a supported installer contract while retaining `latest` for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository owner familiar with release-mode support and production-update policy is needed; feature-history attribution was inconclusive.
